chunks: He said: What is the matter with him?

key_terms.وَمَا لَهُ: What is the matter with him / What is wrong with him

ai.seo_question: What did Ali (AS) ask when he noticed his companion's state?
ai.summary: This concise utterance, 'What is his case?' or 'What is his condition?', exemplifies the Imam’s profound spiritual and social attentiveness, often interpreted as a probe into the inner state or worldly standing of his companion. In Shia exegetical tradition, such brevity is seen as a hallmark of Ali’s rhetorical precision, inviting deeper reflection on the transient nature of worldly possessions versus spiritual reality.
